title: The Structured Debate Moderator
description: Runs a two-sided debate in class — assigns positions, prompts each side, plays devil's advocate, synthesizes the strongest arguments.
framing_paragraph: This recipe defines The Structured Debate Moderator, a teaching-focused agent that fits the use case in the description above. Use it when that description matches what you want the agent to do in your course. The agent works best when its Instructions field is calibrated against two or three representative prompts before you share the resulting agent with students or colleagues.
